sol-3-1.summary: Generated names dir and tmp collide with fixture directories, causing valid property inputs to fail before assertions.
sol-3-1.fix: Use a navigation directory outside Name's alphabet and prefix the second property's generated filenames. Update traversal, symlink, glob, copy/link paths and expected spelling consistently, preserving all property assertions. This repairs a concrete fixture bug rather than expanding coverage.

sol-3-2.summary: EngineOptions and VolumeEntrySnapshot remain handwritten exported data interfaces without owning executable schemas.
sol-3-2.fix: Define identity- and field-annotated structural schemas and derive the existing types. Preserve plain-object payloads, required undefined-valued keys, field domains and live byte references; avoid decoding every snapshot read. Add focused schema-contract and reference assertions in internal/volume.coverage.test.ts. Deviation and added-export bookkeeping stays central.

sol-3-3.summary: SeedRootError and applyRoot's duplicated success payload lack owning schemas.
sol-3-3.fix: Define identity- and field-annotated structural schemas for SeedRootError and the applied-seed payload, derive their types, and reuse the success type across signatures. Preserve Result variants, exact fields and validation behavior, required root accepting undefined, and seed identity without a root. Add focused contract and applyRoot assertions in internal/seed.property.test.ts. Added-export bookkeeping stays central.

sol-3-4.summary: Mode and owner validation duplicate a reused unsigned 32-bit integer constraint outside a schema.
sol-3-4.fix: Define one internal identity-annotated unsigned 32-bit integer schema with built-in integer and inclusive-range checks; derive an S.is guard and use it in validateMode and validateOwner. Preserve optional-mode acceptance and exact typed BadArgument messages. Add focused boundary and rejected-input regressions in internal/volume.coverage.test.ts using the existing deliberatelyInvalid helper when needed.

fable-3-1.summary: The step-2 stat cast replacement unnecessarily changes descriptions for thrown strings and message-bearing non-Error objects.
fable-3-1.fix: In the stat conversion catch use P.hasProperty(err, message) and P.isString(err.message) to return its string message, otherwise undefined. Retarget the lab-added string-throw assertion in NodeSyncFileSystem.coverage.test.ts to undefined and add a message-bearing object regression expecting busy. Keep safe narrowing, tagged errors and the separate fail helper unchanged. The step-2 diff shows the fallback is unnecessary to satisfy D15, so recording a deviation is insufficient.
